陈家客厅，陈近岳气呼呼的拿着皮带一下下狠狠的抽打着陈少峰。而陈少峰就那么笔直的站着，咬着牙一声不吭。

旁边就站着陈母和陈洛兮，陈母刚回家就看见丈夫怒气冲冲的踹门而入。边走边抽腰带，她知道这次儿子是犯了大错了。所以在陈近岳抽打儿子时他并没有插话。

陈近岳一连抽了十下之后了把皮带往茶几上一扔说：“你给我解释解释什么叫以正合，以奇胜，奇正相生，不可胜穷，然奇非谲诈之谓，乃堂堂之正，应变之奇。”

陈少峰立正后回答道：“这句话的意思是作战时，先用常规、正面的力量与敌人交锋，再运用出其不意的奇兵取胜，二者相互依存转化，战术无穷。但此处“奇”并非指欺诈，而是正大光明应对变化的策略。”

陈近岳气呼呼的说：“你踏马还知道“奇”不是欺诈呀？我还以为你学到狗身上去了，你现在大大小小也是个连级干部了，怎么还越学越回去了。知道我为什么打你了吗？“

陈少峰正色道：“知道，我上周算计王野。”

陈近岳：“行，你知道就好，一会儿跟我去给王野道歉。”

陈少峰露出一脸不情愿。陈近岳声音都提高了几分说：“怎么一个大老爷们儿敢做不敢当呀？”

陈少峰见父亲又要发火赶紧说：“我去，我去。”

陈近岳转头对陈洛兮说：“兮兮你的事我已经办了，狠狠的批了那个臭小子一顿，要不是他你秦叔拦着我非抽他一顿不可。”

陈洛兮磕磕巴巴的说：“那......那......。”

陈近岳一拍脑门儿说：“宝贝闺女呀，别那了。再那下去你爸爸的老脸就丢完了。”

陈洛兮听了父亲这话害羞的跑回房了。陈母一看这样转头就问：“老陈怎么回事儿呀？”

陈近岳说：“你没问呀？”

陈母白了他一眼说：“我和你就前后脚进门，我问什么呀？”

陈近岳坐在沙发上叹了口气说：“造孽呀......。”

然后就一五一十的把事情跟陈母讲述了一遍。陈母一脸好奇的问：“这个王野怎么样呀？”

陈近岳一脸厌恶的说：“就是个小混蛋。他就在老秦家，一会儿你跟着去看看不就知道了。”

陈近岳缓了一会儿就带着妻子和陈少峰去了秦家。秦家现在已经吃完饭了，正在喝茶，王野则陪着秦天悦玩儿。这小丫头太可爱了，一声声哥哥叫的王野心都化了。

陈近岳一家三口一进门就看见了这温馨的一幕。陈母看见陪着秦天悦玩的王野一脸吃惊的说：“咦，小伙子是你呀？”

王野一下就想起来笑呵呵的说：“韩院长，真巧呀没想到您竟然是陈大爷的爱人。”

一屋子的大人都好奇的看着两人，陈近岳指着王野说：“你认识这个臭小子？”

韩副院长说：“认识啊，前段时间我不是跟你说了吗，有个小伙子帮了一对姐弟。”

陈近岳用手点着王野说：“这臭小子有这么好心？”

韩副院长白了陈近岳一眼也不搭理他，继续跟王野说道：“你是叫王野吧，我叫韩雅芝，上次匆忙也没问你叫什么，既然你是老秦的外甥，咱们也不算外人了。以后我叫你小野，你叫我伯母就行。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“好的伯母。”

韩雅芝笑呵呵的说：“小野，听说你可是把我姑娘惹哭了啊。”

王野心想：“我擦，刚才还和蔼可亲的，这接着就兴师问罪了吗。”

In the living room of the Chen family, Chen Jinyue angrily beat Chen Shaofeng with a belt.But Chen Shaofeng just stood upright, gritting his teeth and saying nothing.

Chen's mother and Chen Luoxi were standing next to them. As soon as Chen's mother came home, she saw her husband kicking in the door angrily.Pulling her belt as she walked, she knew her son had made a big mistake this time.So he didn't interrupt when Chen Jinyue whipped his son.

After Chen Jinyue slapped him ten times in a row, he threw the belt on the coffee table and said, "Explain to me what it means to be upright and harmonious, to win with surprise. Strangeness and rightness are mutually reinforcing, and there is no limit to victory. However, strangeness is not deceitful, but uprightness, and the wonder of adaptability."

After standing at attention, Chen Shaofeng replied: "The meaning of this sentence is that when fighting, first use conventional and frontal forces to confront the enemy, and then use unexpected surprise troops to win. The two are interdependent and transform, and the tactics are endless. But the "odd" here does not refer to deception, but an upright strategy to deal with changes."

Chen Jinyue said angrily: "You know that "Qi" is not a deception when you are riding a horse? I thought you learned from dogs. You are now a company-level cadre, how come you keep learning more and more? Do you know why I beat you?"

Chen Shaofeng said seriously: "I know, I plotted against Wang Ye last week."

Chen Jinyue: "Okay, as long as you know, follow me later to apologize to Wang Ye."

Chen Shaofeng showed a look of reluctance.Chen Jinyue's voice rose a bit and he said, "Why does a grown man dare to do this?"

When Chen Shaofeng saw that his father was about to get angry again, he quickly said: "I'll go, I'll go."

Chen Jinyue turned to Chen Luoxi and said, "Xixi, I have already taken care of your matter and gave that brat a good beating. If he hadn't been for your uncle Qin stopping me, I would have given him a good beating."

Chen Luoxi stuttered and said, "Then...that..."

Chen Jinyue slapped his forehead and said, "My dear girl, don't do that. If you keep doing that, your father will be completely disgraced."

After hearing what her father said, Chen Luoxi ran back to her room shyly.When Chen's mother saw this, she turned around and asked, "What's going on with Old Chen?"

Chen Jinyue said: "You didn't ask?"

Mother Chen rolled her eyes at him and said, "You and I will walk in front and back. What do I ask?"

Chen Jinyue sat on the sofa and sighed: "What a sin..."

Then he told Mother Chen everything in detail.Mother Chen asked curiously: "How is this Wang Ye?"

Chen Jinyue said with a look of disgust: "He's just a little bastard. He's at Lao Qin's house. You'll find out later if you follow him to see him."

After Chen Jinyue calmed down for a while, he took his wife and Chen Shaofeng to Qin's house.The Qin family has finished their meal now and are drinking tea, while Wang Ye plays with Qin Tianyue.This little girl is so cute, Wang Zhi's ambition melts every time she calls her brother.

Chen Jinyue's family of three saw this heartwarming scene as soon as they entered the door.Mother Chen saw Wang Ye playing with Qin Tianyue and said with surprise: "Hey, is that you, young man?"

Wang Ye remembered it immediately and said with a smile: "Dean Han, what a coincidence. I didn't expect you to be Uncle Chen's lover."

All the adults in the room looked at the two of them curiously. Chen Jinyue pointed at Wang Ye and said, "Do you know this brat?"

Vice President Han said: "We know each other. Didn't I tell you some time ago that there was a young man who helped a pair of siblings."

Chen Jinyue pointed Wang Ye with his hand and said, "Is this brat so kind?"

Vice President Han rolled his eyes at Chen Jinyue and ignored him, and continued to talk to Wang Ye: "Your name is Wang Ye, my name is Han Yazhi. I didn't ask you what your name was last time in a hurry. Since you are Lao Qin's nephew, we are not outsiders. From now on, I will call you Xiaoye, and you can call me aunt."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Okay, Auntie."

Hanya Zhi said with a smile: "Xiaoye, I heard that you made my girl cry."

Wang Ye thought: "I wonder, I was so amiable just now, but now I'm going to start an army to hold him accountable."
